title: Increase model depth
description: Increased DEPTH from 8 to 10 layers; scaled model_dim 512→640, n_head 4→5
reflection: Hypothesis failed. Deeper model (10 layers, 640 dim) achieved val_bpb 1.000906 vs baseline 0.996598 (+0.004 regression). Peak VRAM increased 55% (44GB→68GB) without performance gain. Interpretation: 5-minute budget insufficient for deeper model convergence, or added depth without proportional width doesn't help. Architecture expansion trades VRAM for worse validation loss.
